related_questions.question: What is the major adverse effect of hydrochlorothiazide?
related_questions.snippet: Hydrochlorothiazide (Microzide) treats high blood pressure and edema (swelling from extra fluid). But, like all medications, it has risks. Hydrochlorothiazide side effects include electrolyte imbalances, dizziness, and weakness. Hydrochlorothiazide can also cause headaches, high blood sugar, and sexual problems.
